courses.name: Computer Science and Engineering
courses.description: Study of computing systems, software development, algorithms, and computational theory.
courses.overview: CSE is one of the most sought-after engineering disciplines focusing on software development, data structures, cloud computing, and software engineering principles.
courses.skills: Python, Java, C++, Data Structures, System Design, SQL, Web Development
courses.careers: Software Development Engineer, Full Stack Developer, Systems Architect, Cloud Engineer
courses.industries: IT & Software, Product Startups, Fintech, E-commerce, AI Labs

courses.name: Artificial Intelligence and Data Science
courses.description: Specialized program in machine learning, deep learning, data analytics, and intelligent systems.
courses.overview: AIDS combines statistical analysis, data processing, and AI model building to solve complex decision-making problems across industries.
courses.skills: Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Python, R, TensorFlow, Data Visualization, Big Data
courses.careers: AI Engineer, Data Scientist, ML Ops Engineer, Data Analyst, BI Developer
courses.industries: Tech Giants, Analytics Firms, Healthcare Tech, Autonomous Mobility, Finance

courses.name: Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning
courses.description: Focused curriculum on neural networks, natural language processing, computer vision, and predictive modeling.
courses.overview: AIML teaches students how to build smart algorithms capable of learning patterns from large datasets and performing autonomous actions.
courses.skills: Neural Networks, NLP, Computer Vision, PyTorch, Model Deployment, Algorithmic Logic
courses.careers: ML Engineer, Computer Vision Engineer, NLP Specialist, Research Scientist
courses.industries: AI Research Labs, Robotics, Defense Tech, Tech Services

courses.name: Information Technology
courses.description: Focuses on application development, network management, web technologies, and enterprise software.
courses.overview: IT engineering emphasizes practical software applications, web engineering, database architecture, and network security.
courses.skills: Web Stack, Cloud Computing, Database Admin, Networking, DevOps
courses.careers: IT Consultant, DevOps Engineer, Full Stack Dev, Database Architect
courses.industries: Enterprise IT, Consulting Services, Telecom, Software Houses

courses.name: Electronics and Communication Engineering
courses.description: Covers semiconductor devices, microprocessors, VLSI, signal processing, and wireless communications.
courses.overview: ECE bridges hardware and software. Students learn embedded systems, IoT architecture, circuit design, and wireless communication protocols.
courses.skills: VLSI Design, Embedded C, Microcontrollers, Signal Processing, MATLAB, Circuit Simulation
courses.careers: Embedded Systems Engineer, VLSI Hardware Engineer, IoT Specialist, Telecom Engineer
courses.industries: Semiconductor Manufacturers, Consumer Electronics, Automotive, Telecom, Defense

courses.name: Electrical and Electronics Engineering
courses.description: Study of electrical power generation, smart grids, electric vehicles, control systems, and power electronics.
courses.overview: EEE focuses on energy systems, renewable power generation, EV battery management, automation, and industrial control.
courses.skills: Power Electronics, Smart Grids, MATLAB, Control Systems, EV Architecture, PLC Automation
courses.careers: Electrical Engineer, Power Systems Analyst, EV Hardware Design Engineer, Automation Engineer
courses.industries: Electric Vehicle Firms, Renewable Energy, Power Sector, Industrial Manufacturing

courses.name: Mechanical Engineering
courses.description: Fundamental engineering branch dealing with thermal systems, CAD/CAM, robotics, and manufacturing technology.
courses.overview: Mechanical Engineering equips students with physical modeling, mechanics, thermal engineering, robotics, and digital manufacturing skills.
courses.skills: CAD/CAM, SolidWorks, ANSYS, Thermodynamics, Mechatronics, Robotics
courses.careers: Design Engineer, Thermal Analyst, Production Engineer, Robotics Specialist
courses.industries: Automotive, Aerospace, Heavy Machinery, Energy, Precision Engineering

courses.name: Civil Engineering
courses.description: Focuses on structural engineering, transportation networks, environmental engineering, and smart city infrastructure.
courses.overview: Civil Engineering involves designing, constructing, and maintaining resilient buildings, bridges, water treatment, and transit networks.
courses.skills: AutoCAD, STAAD Pro, Structural Analysis, Geotechnical Engg, Project Estimation
courses.careers: Structural Engineer, Construction Manager, Site Engineer, Urban Planner
courses.industries: Infrastructure Firms, Real Estate Development, Government Public Works, Metro Projects

courses.name: Cyber Security
courses.description: Specialized program covering network security, ethical hacking, cryptography, and digital forensics.
courses.overview: Cyber Security prepares students to protect corporate and government infrastructure against cyber attacks, vulnerability exploits, and data breaches.
courses.skills: Ethical Hacking, Network Security, Cryptography, Penetration Testing, SOC Operations
courses.careers: Cyber Security Analyst, Penetration Tester, Security Consultant, SOC Lead
courses.industries: Cybersecurity Agencies, Banking & Finance, Defense, Enterprise Security
